title: Jeremy Turner II (Morehouse College · Morgan Stanley HBCU Scholar) — starts 4-week Extern Corporate Strategy Externship on the Incorruptible framework
summary: Jeremy Turner II — Morehouse College Business Administration/Finance undergraduate and Morgan Stanley HBCU Scholar — begins the four-week Corporate Strategy Externship guided by Eric Ries. He'll analyze real companies using the Incorruptible framework: SEC filings, proxy statements, board composition, and strategic recommendations grounded in the book's governance lens. Second Extern participant to surface publicly this cycle.
blockquote: Excited to start my four-week Corporate Strategy Externship with Extern, guided by Eric Ries. Over the next month, I'll be analyzing real companies using the Incorruptible framework, with a focus on financial pressures, corporate governance, and long-term strategy. I'll also be working with SEC filings and proxy statements, evaluating board composition, and developing strategic recommendations based on my analysis.
